svg.text: Back analysis: most and least frequent numbers
Matches of every draw #1–#3305 with the 14 most and 14 least frequent numbers before it (3,305 draws)
14 most frequent: 8.00 matches per draw vs 7.98 expected (+68.92 in total, z = 0.96)
14 least frequent: 7.97 matches per draw vs 7.98 expected (−10.08 in total, z = -0.14)
Matches expected by chance (14 numbers vs a group of 14 from 25 gives 7.84)
Groups are ranked on all draws before each draw; ties go to the lower number. Early rankings rest on very few draws. z: total excess over its chance spread, draws treated as independent.
